bindPose.pose: A-pose (native Rocketbox bind pose = glTF rest pose; no animations in file)
bindPose.space: glTF world, meters, +Y up, character faces +Z, character left = +X; joint origins in the rest (bind) pose
bindPose.axes: 3ds Max Biped joint frames: spine/limb/finger joints point to their child along local +X; hands: palm normal = local +Y (both sides); root node Bip01 has identity transform

notes: Black suit, white shirt; red tie recolored to black. LOD0 is the Rocketbox hipoly_81_bones mesh; LOD1/LOD2 are meshoptimizer simplifications of it (original vertices kept; the repo FBX ships no other LOD meshes). In three.js each LOD node is a Group with one SkinnedMesh child per material; all share one Skeleton.
